targets.expected_type: ∀ x y : ℝ, ClosedFormActivation.relu.pair (x,y) = (max x y,y)
targets.scope: The generic closed-form datatype specializes literally to max and identity for ReLU.

targets.expected_type: ∀ a : ClosedFormActivation, ConvexPairActivation a.pair ∧ Monotone a.pair ∧ ValidPairActivation a.eval a.pair ∧ NonnegativePairActivation a.pair
targets.scope: Actual explicit ReLU, Gaussian GELU, positive-scale Swish, sigmoid and positive-temperature Softplus formulas satisfy the whole scalar interface.

targets.expected_type: ∀ {n m k : ℕ} (net : Network n m), net.Nonnegative → ∀ (a : ClosedFormActivation) (wp wn : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ), (∀ i j, 0 ≤ wp i j) → (∀ i j, 0 ≤ wn i j) → ∀ bp bn : Vec k, Monotone (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn) ∧ (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : PairVec n => (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn x).1 i)) ∧ (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : PairVec n => (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn x).2 i)) ∧ ∀ x : PairVec n, (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn x).1 - (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn x).2 = affineLayer wp wn bp bn (net.forwardWith a.eval (x.1 - x.2))
targets.scope: The actual explicit branches yield convex monotone complete two-stream networks with an ungated signed affine output and exact same-parameter recovery.

targets.expected_type: ∀ {n m k : ℕ} (net : Network n m), net.Nonnegative → ∀ (a : ClosedFormActivation) (wp wn : Matrix (Fin k) (Fin m) ℝ), (∀ i j, 0 ≤ wp i j) → (∀ i j, 0 ≤ wn i j) → ∀ bp bn : Vec k, Monotone (fun x : Vec n => net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)) ∧ (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : Vec n => (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)).1 i)) ∧ (∀ i, ConvexOn ℝ Set.univ (fun x : Vec n => (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)).2 i)) ∧ ∀ x : Vec n, (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)).1 - (net.affineDecomposeWith a.pair wp wn bp bn (x,0)).2 = affineLayer wp wn bp bn (net.forwardWith a.eval x)
targets.scope: The affine input embedding produces ordinary-input convex monotone heads with exact recovery, without asserting their nonnegativity.
